name: Domain-Specific Number-Theoretic Surrogate
description: Replaces a recognizable algebraic inequality (distinct roots) with a mathematically equivalent but conceptually unrelated number-theoretic property (GCD of factorials). For the specific domain {1, 2, 3}, the condition `gcd(a!, b!) < max(a, b)` exactly encodes `a != b`. This defeats models that rely on recognizing the graph coloring structure to apply specialized heuristic solvers (like degree-ordering), forcing them to fall back to naive backtracking which will TLE.
